Their moderately aggressive pressing, reflected by a PPDA of 11.5 versus Harbour City’s 13.0, disrupted Harbour City's patient short passing and reduced their field tilt to 42.9%, forcing transitions under pressure. The saved header by Kian Adeyemi illustrates the mechanism of creating chances through aerial overloads and wide crosses, despite their overall negative momentum index of -0.676 implying incomplete control. Meanwhile, Harbour City's lower field tilt but higher possession (56%) and xG (0.15) suggests effective rest-defence, absorbing pressure to maintain territorial balance.
